storage: Airtight jar, cool, dry and dark; whole seeds keep their aroma longer than powder.
looksLike: small, boat-shaped, ridged, greenish-brown to beige seeds with a warm, earthy, slightly bitter smell.
howToPick: whole, uniform seeds with a strong warm smell; avoid dusty seeds with stems or stones, or a faint smell.
shelfLife: about 12 months sealed (general guidance; not from a source in this run).
